importantFindings.title: Process: I checked the erasing phone's storage, not the account's other phone
importantFindings.evidence: SP-B6-1 found the erased course in the raw storage of a second phone that lost it through the download. The erase path compacted; the download path did not. The open after a course leaves now compacts, and a live two-phone test scans the second phone's raw IndexedDB, with a control run (compaction disabled) that fails.
importantFindings.reproduction: tests/e2e/b6-erase-live.spec.ts, 'the account's other phone drops the erased course, and its storage keeps nothing of it'.

importantFindings.title: Process: a cleanup keyed on 'no course' was broader than the case it served, twice
importantFindings.evidence: DI-B6-1: dropping refusals whenever no course is left also dropped a course whose own row the server refused. DI-B6-R2-1: my interim fix for the missing migration turned one delete into a standing order. Both were reproduced by the reviewer and are now covered: courseLeftThisDevice keeps a refused own course; the record is forgotten once its delete ran (fake test 'not repeated later').
